daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

President Prabowo Subianto is set to submit two names to replace Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka to the MPR on 25 November 2026, with a series of scenarios prepared for the vice-presidential election. PAN chairman Zulhas said almost all party leaders agreed not to propose their own cadres and that the vice president should come from Gerindra. Former President Megawati Soekarnoputri declined an offer to join the government, saying she prefers to remain outside, and separately criticized leaders who fail due to ambition and lamented declining ethics and morals amid collective corruption.

  • The DPR passed the Asset Forfeiture Law, prompting the KPK to pledge compliance while highlighting four legal offences not yet covered by the new legislation, as ICW reported DPR Speaker Puan Maharani and Habiburokhman to the Parliamentary Ethics Council over the law's passage.
  • Police postponed the expose of the alleged treason case involving former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo and colleagues until next week.
  • Subhan Palal, the plaintiff behind the certificate lawsuit against Gibran, reported an expert witness from Gibran's volunteer team to police following a Constitutional Court hearing.
  • The Communications and Digital Affairs Ministry met with Google to discuss the closure of 19,389 Indonesian-language YouTube channels.
  • DPR Commission V urged accelerated handling of flooding in Aceh, while Commission VIII will summon the BNPB chief next week to discuss floods in Aceh and Sumatra.
  • The Attorney General's Office questioned former Bekasi Mayor Mochtar Mohamad over an alleged oil and gas joint operation corruption case.
  • The Public Communication Agency (Bakom) stated public satisfaction with the president increased following the arrest of Listyo Sigit and colleagues.

Foreign Policy & Defence

President Prabowo Subianto held a one-on-one meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen, and separately discussed South China Sea cooperation with Chinese President Xi Jinping. Prabowo identified corruption and drug trafficking as major challenges facing Indonesia during the APEC leaders' meeting, which resulted in APEC leaders committing to refuse asylum for corruption perpetrators.

  • The Indonesian Air Force is exploring a pilot training partnership with Australia to enhance TNI AU capabilities.
  • Health Minister Budi outlined a three-pillar reform vision as part of Indonesia's candidacy for a WHO leadership role.
  • Indonesia attracted buyer interest for 159,000 tons CO2e at the COP31 CarbonNex carbon trading platform.
  • The Indonesian migrant worker protection agency (KP2MI) is exploring potential placement for healthcare workers in Slovakia.
  • Estonia has offered digital technology to boost Indonesia's public service efficiency and highlighted maritime cooperation opportunities with Indonesia.

Other

Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung set the 2027 provincial minimum wage for Jakarta at Rp 6.1 million, representing a significant increase for the capital's workers. The head of the National Nutrition Agency (BGN) stated that raw material spending for the free nutritious meals program reached Rp 145 trillion in 2026, and emphasized that priority will be given to remote areas and regions with high stunting rates while ensuring the program has real economic impact.

  • Krakatau Steel and JOVO are developing an LNG terminal in Cilegon to support industrial energy needs.
  • The Environment Ministry is seeking to remove Ujung Kulon waters from designated mining zones to protect the Javan rhino habitat.
  • Indonesia's disaster agency (BNPB) has developed a satellite system to track land and forest fires in real time.
  • The Ministry of Law and Human Rights blocked 700,000 business entities but is ready to reopen them if their data is updated, while discovering that 35 ministries and agencies handle intellectual property matters.
  • Indonesia is boosting five halal industry clusters to strengthen its position in the global halal market.
